festivals.what: Wan Lai, Chon Buri's own Songkran tradition, is held after the national 13 to 15 April holiday. In 2026 the province-wide Wan Lai season ran 5 to 20 April; Pattaya's Songkran Summer Festival (Wan Lai) was 17 to 19 April on Central Pattaya Beach, and Si Racha's festival 19 to 21 April at Si Racha Bay Seaside Health Park.
Pattaya International Fireworks Festival 2026: 27 and 28 November, Pattaya Beach. Pattaya International Jazz Festival 2026: 6 and 7 November, Pattaya Beach.

moving_calendars: Wan Lai: set by the province and city each April, after 13 to 15 April.
culture-cycles.note: Wan Lai dates are set locally each year, after the national Songkran days.
